scope: Eight separately frozen prior-predictive synthetic datasets; bounded computational calibration pilot, not precise coverage
stopping: Exactly eight four-chain 256/2048 budgets, one dataset at a time. No truth/seed replacement, exclusions, adaptive budgets or extension until pass. Stop launching batches when a full 2400-second reservation does not fit the remaining cumulative 16-hour sampling wall budget. Idle paused time is free; crashed/unacknowledged batches keep the entire reservation.
ranks: One final retained endpoint per independent chain; ranks 0..4. Tie RNG domain [0x55,analysis_seed,mock_id,coordinate]. Five scalar, six fixed field projections and likelihood Q; no asymptotic uniformity test or passing-subset calibration claim.
runtime: Budget covers runner sampling, refresh and replay wall time across invocations. Measured successful batches refund unused reservations. An active final batch may finish past its reservation; any overrun is charged. Analysis is separate. Graceful SIGTERM/PAUSE drains checkpoints. Preserve partial mocks when capped.
